mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, directly increasing the present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < -0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and declines in unemployment rate signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom defined by new home construction above 1300.0 thousand units signals rising consumer confidence and spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST > 1300.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenues and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < -0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in new home construction and industrial production signal a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST declines and INDPRO declines, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment directly boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion with GDP growth above 2.5% annualized, consumer and business spending remain robust, supporting strong corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.
